ruled_out_vectors.vector: Forge permit with arbitrary feeOnTop (unsigned field) to drain extra tokens
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Signer's limitAmount caps total exposure. Even with arbitrary feeOnTop, the swap reverts if output falls below limitAmount. Known low-severity, below L-009 threshold.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Spoof executor context to settle orders with wrong recipient
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: ammHandleTransfer requires msg.sender == AMM. Only the AMM can call transfer handlers. Guard at PermitTransferHandler.sol:115 and CLOBTransferHandler.sol:230.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Replay CLOB order with different nonce context
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Orders bound to maker address (CLOBHelper.sol:36 check) and global nonce counter (nextOrderNonce++). No replay possible.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Redirect fee to attacker address via hook configuration
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: All AMMStandardHook settings mutations require _requireCallerIsRegistry(). Registry uses creator token standards ACL. Not externally exploitable.
Cosignature uses _hashTypedDataV4 (chain-specific domain). PermitC uses chain-specific domain separator. Only destroyCosigner uses universal domain (known CP-002, low severity).

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Deploy ERC-1271 contract that returns true for any hash to bypass signature checks
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: ERC-1271 signer would be attacker's own contract. Can only drain tokens they approved from their own contract. Self-inflicted, no victim.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Call flash-loan/swap callback directly to get credited without providing capital
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: afterSwapRefund and ammHandleTransfer both check msg.sender == AMM. Cannot call directly.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Malicious permitProcessor that returns success without transferring tokens
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: AMM independently verifies balance increased by amountIn at AMMModule.sol:2207-2210. If tokens not received, entire swap reverts regardless of handler return value.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Forge cross-module caller context to bypass access control on hooks
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: All state-changing AMMStandardHook functions check _requireCallerIsAMM() at line 940-943. Cannot call with fake context.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Reuse permit signature with different from address to drain another user's tokens
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: from address is part of PermitC typehash and signed by signer. Changing from invalidates signature.

theft_theses.thesis: Forge permit with arbitrary feeOnTop to drain signer's tokens beyond intended swap
Supply malicious permitProcessor to execute swap without actual token transfer
Manipulate CLOB order fill math via price/rounding to extract from makers
